scripts.build:canary: vite build && bun -e "const fs=require('fs'); fs.writeFileSync('dist/index.html', fs.readFileSync('dist/index.html','utf8').replace(/ crossorigin/g, ''));" && electrobun build --env=canary
scripts.build:desktop: vite build && bun -e "const fs=require('fs'); fs.writeFileSync('dist/index.html', fs.readFileSync('dist/index.html','utf8').replace(/ crossorigin/g, ''));" && electrobun build --env=dev
